purpose: Authoritative-source map for Jondo's 3.6.10.10 parity work. This is an evidence registry, not a bulk scraper or an automatic database import.

truthOrder.source: Installed 3.6.10.10 client and version-pinned extracted snapshot
Official Dofus / Ankama pages and release notes
Captured 3.6.10.10 client/server traffic and controlled in-game tests
doesNotProve: behaviour not exercised by the capture

truthOrder.source: Version-checked third-party catalogues and community guides

sources.label: DOFUS official Updates / release notes
sources.versionRule: Record the published date and explicit game version on each referenced page. A note without an explicit version is design evidence only.

sources.label: DOFUS official Encyclopedia
sources.versionRule: Treat the page as current unless a dated release note pins the information; cross-check IDs against the local client snapshot.

sources.label: DOFUS official game guides and news
sources.versionRule: Use a guide only alongside an in-client capture before marking an interaction implemented.

sources.label: Ankama official status and service communication
useFor: explaining a public outage or maintenance window
sources.versionRule: Never promote operational notices into gameplay behaviour.

requiredForImplementation: captured or otherwise verified request/reply flow when the feature is networked
acceptancePolicy.officialPageRole: Official pages produce a traceable requirement and regression test; they do not directly mutate world.db or account data.
